interface.title: HIV trends and treatment access
interface.field: Public health / HIV epidemiology (Southeast Asia, UNAIDS and World Bank national estimates)
interface.stage_of_work: Descriptive comparison and exploratory secondary analysis of a stored, read-only research snapshot; sharing results
interface.what_it_is_for: Lets a researcher compare HIV indicators across 11 Southeast Asian countries and years, inspect the 2025 treatment cascade and the number of people not on ART, review clustered panel-model sensitivity checks for the ART–mortality association, relate GDP to ART coverage, and export tables or run fixed read-only SQL examples.

data.note: A committed snapshot (UNAIDS 2026, WHO GHO, World Bank WDI) covering 11 countries from 1990 to 2025, stored as CSVs, a SQLite database and precomputed model results. Nothing is uploaded. The sidebar Countries/Years filters change only the Trends and Data explorer tabs. Cascade, Model and GDP tabs show fixed samples. Censored values show as thresholds such as '>98' in the cascade table, as gaps in charts and as None in SQL results; '...' marks missing countries (Brunei, Singapore).
